It's okay to feel upset about this."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Thanks. I guess I just keep thinking about all the time and effort I put into the application. It feels like it's always something."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Your dedication is amazing, Kelly. Even if this didn’t work out, it doesn’t take away from all the effort you’ve put in."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"It's hard to keep that perspective when these things happen back to back. It just adds to feeling stuck, you know?"},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Absolutely, and it's important to acknowledge that feeling. Have you thought about what you might do next?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I'm trying to keep my options open.
